env_analysis.evidence: README.md 'Requirements' section states 'Python 3.5 or 3.6, Tensorflow 0.7'; code uses deprecated TF <1.0 API calls (tf.batch_matmul, old tf.concat argument order)

run.output_tail: Repo only ships a small unwired 'data/toy' folder (gold_clusters.txt, mention/pairwise feature hdf5 stubs) that is not referenced by any train_*.sh script; real training requires the full CoNLL-2012 corpus preprocessed via modifiedBCS/create_data.sh, which itself requires LDC-licensed OntoNotes 5.0 raw text.

agent_parsed_json.verdict_reason: Reproduction is blocked by two independent genuine (non-pipeline) issues: (1) training data requires OntoNotes 5.0 / CoNLL-2012 corpus which is LDC-licensed and cannot be freely downloaded, and (2) the exact required framework (TensorFlow 0.7, pre-1.0 API used directly in the code) has no pullable Docker image left on Docker Hub (legacy manifest format rejected by modern containerd), and the repo's own bundled 'toy' data is not wired into any of the provided training scripts.
